Derivation of the Dual Problem:  The dual problem is derived by taking a linear combination of the primal problem's constraints using Lagrange multipliers. The dual problem is obtained by minimizing the dual function $g(\vec{y}) = \inf_{\vec{x}} \mathcal{L}(\vec{x}, \vec{y}) = \vec{b}^T\vec{y}$ subject to $A^T\vec{y} \ge \vec{c}$ and $\vec{y} \ge 0$. <L[2024-10-01-DualGeneralLP] 1><L[2024-10-01-DualGeneralLP] 3><L[2024-10-01-DualGeneralLP] 4><L[2024-10-01-DualGeneralLP] 6><L[2024-10-01-DualGeneralLP] 7>
